## Outcome

What changes for the person using Gen4Zero? What is intentionally out of scope?

## Risk

- Level: R0 / R1 / R2 / R3
- Public contracts touched: recipe / determinism / storage / export / accessibility / privacy / performance / release / domain / none
- Change Record, if required:

## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run verify:release`
- [ ] Exact recipe or interaction path supplied
- [ ] Desktop and narrow-screen review, if layout changed
- [ ] Export dimensions/visual result reviewed, if rendering changed
- [ ] Keyboard and reduced-motion behavior reviewed, if interaction changed
- [ ] No credentials, unpublished works, generated `dist/`, or unrelated files

## Human judgment requested

State the specific decision a reviewer should make. Attach privacy-safe screenshots or exported samples and distinguish taste feedback from functional acceptance.

## Rollback

Name the last-known-good commit and the condition that should trigger rollback.
